title: Format with %
prompt: Return "NAME has N hp" using a format string instead of joining pieces.
hints: %s is a slot for text and %d a slot for a whole number.

docs.name: "%s has %d hp" % [name, hp]
docs.what: Fills the slots: %s takes text, %d a whole number. Values come after the % in an array.

solution:
func format_status(name, hp):
	return "%s has %d hp" % [name, hp]
